findings.mechanism: Correlation identifiers generated per service rather than propagated by the transport. Logs cannot be queried by a single request ID, making the service undiagnosable when it breaks.
findings.remediation: Inject a request‑scoped correlation ID into the logger context and include it in every log message emitted by this module.
findings.arithmetic: traceable_requests = 0 / total_requests = 0 % → on‑call cannot retrieve all logs for a request

findings.mechanism: Errors counted but not attributed, so a rate exists with no way to act on it. The generic except block swallows all exceptions and only logs a generic message, providing no structured error metric.
findings.remediation: Catch specific exception types and emit structured error metrics with error‑type tags instead of a blanket exception handler.
findings.arithmetic: attributed_error_rate = 0 % because all errors are logged without classification → on‑call cannot determine error cause
